# The generated area

Everything under `Source/Generated/` is written by `Scripts/Prepare.ts` from
the `Module/Aphrodite` submodule, on every build. Nothing here is edited by
hand: a change made in this directory is overwritten by the next run.

## What lands here

- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/crates/aphrodite/Cargo.toml` (Facts) - Source/Library/Versions.ts, /versions/
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/crates/aphrodite-hermes/Cargo.toml` (Facts) - Source/Library/Versions.ts, /versions/
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/plugins/aphrodite/plugin.yaml` (Facts) - Source/Library/Versions.ts, the footer stamp, /plugin/
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/plugins/aphrodite/BINARY_VERSION` (Facts) - /setup/, /plugin/ (the version the downloader pins)
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/vendor/headroom/crates/headroom-core/Cargo.toml` (Facts) - /versions/ (the vendored fork's library version)
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Versions.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/CHANGELOG.md` (Facts) - /versions/ (the release monument), /history/ (the quoted entries)
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Plugin.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/plugins/aphrodite/plugin.yaml` (Facts) - /plugin/, /tools/, /hooks/ (the hook and tool registries)
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Config.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/aphrodite.toml.example` (Facts) - /config/, /setup/ (every key with the default the repo ships)
- `Source/Generated/Facts/Config.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/crates/aphrodite/templates/aphrodite.toml` (Facts) - /config/ (the structure `aphrodite setup` writes)
- `Source/Generated/Module.json` <- `Module/Aphrodite/package.json` (Facts) - every generated header's provenance, the README's pin line
- `Source/Generated/Primary/README.md` <- `Module/Aphrodite/README.md` (Copy) - /versions/ (the release badges, the tier table), /setup/
- `Source/Generated/Primary/plugin.yaml` <- `Module/Aphrodite/plugins/aphrodite/plugin.yaml` (Copy) - /plugin/ (the manifest a reader can read in full)

## What is declared and held

These rows are verified on every run and written by the extraction card that
owns them, not by this one:

- `docs/**` -> `Source/Content/Docs/**` (Doc) - Held for the docs extraction card. The module tree is the same one the committed collection was generated from, so that card's work is repointing Scripts/Docs/Generate.ts and Source/Library/Versions.ts at the module - not re-extracting text. Prepare verifies the tree on every run and reports its file count.
- `docs/**` -> `Source/Content/Mermaid/**` (Mermaid) - Downstream of the docs row: the extractor reads the generated markdown, so this row cannot land before that one.

## How a fact changes

Never in this directory. Edit `~/Developer/Application/PlayForm/Aphrodite`,
port to `Aphrodite-Release`, commit, push, verify the remote tip, advance the
`Module/Aphrodite` pin in this repository, then rebuild. The eight steps are
in the site README.

## The additive law

A source file with no manifest row is a gap in the manifest, not a licence to
skip content. A page with no module counterpart survives generation: it is
pushed up into `PlayForm/Aphrodite` so it gains a source, or the manifest
declares it site-only with a reason. Generation is the union of the best
content at both ends, never the intersection.
